title: Verify annotation tag updates against the join table
answers: Annotation tags look correct but tag filtering shows removed tags
How do I test that replacing annotation tags removes old links?
Why can an annotation Tags assertion miss stale tag links?
body:
Invariant: Annotation tag changes must keep annotation.tags and annotation_tag consistent; link maintenance lives in pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go:ensureTags.
Visibility: Get builds ItemDTO.Tags from annotation.tags, while GetTags uses annotation_tag for filtering, so DTO assertions alone can pass with stale links.
Test convention: pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store_test.go:TestIntegrationAnnotations queries annotation_tag joined to tag for the annotation ID and checks the exact tag set with ElementsMatch after replacing a tag.
applies: Implementation and integration tests for replacing or removing annotation tags.
